metadata.archetype_justification: Service accepts purchase order submissions via SOAP and writes them to an Oracle database. It owns persistent state (partner_orders table) and exposes a write endpoint (submitOrder). Classified as stateful-crud.

top_gaps.title: Secrets Management
top_gaps.gap: Plaintext Oracle credentials hardcoded in source code
top_gaps.impact: Critical security vulnerability; credentials exposed in version control

top_gaps.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
top_gaps.gap: No IaC — all infrastructure manually provisioned
top_gaps.impact: Cannot reproduce environments; no disaster recovery automation

top_gaps.title: Managed Databases
top_gaps.impact: High operational burden; no automated failover, patching, or scaling

top_gaps.title: Monolith vs Microservices
top_gaps.gap: Single tightly-coupled class with no module boundaries
top_gaps.impact: Cannot scale, deploy, or evolve independently

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline — manual Ant build
top_gaps.impact: No automated testing, no repeatable deployments

findings.title: Managed Compute - All compute on EOL JBoss/RHEL
findings.description: All compute runs on JBoss AS 5.1 deployed on RHEL 6. No managed compute services (ECS, EKS, Lambda, Fargate) detected.
findings.gap: No managed compute — entire workload on a manually provisioned, end-of-life application server on an end-of-life OS.
findings.recommendation: Containerize the application and deploy on ECS/Fargate or EKS. Rewrite to Spring Boot/Quarkus and deploy as a container or Lambda function.

findings.title: Managed Databases - Self-managed Oracle 11g
findings.description: Database is Oracle 11g accessed via hardcoded JDBC connection to IP address 10.0.9.30:1521:PARTDB. Self-managed Oracle instance with no managed database service.
findings.gap: Entirely self-managed database with no automated failover, patching, backup, or scaling. Oracle 11g is past end-of-life.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS or Aurora PostgreSQL. Use AWS DMS for data migration.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration - No orchestration for order processing
findings.description: No workflow orchestration services detected. The submitOrder operation performs XML parsing, DB insert in a single synchronous method with no error recovery.
findings.gap: No orchestration — order processing logic hardcoded in a single method with no error handling strategy.
findings.recommendation: Adopt Step Functions for multi-step order processing workflow with built-in retry and error handling.

findings.title: Async Messaging - No messaging infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure detected. Service processes orders synchronously with no decoupling.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — partner is tightly coupled to database operation.
findings.recommendation: Introduce SQS or EventBridge to decouple order submission from order processing.

findings.title: Network Security - No VPC or network controls
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, security group, or network segmentation configuration found. Service exposed over plain HTTP.
findings.gap: No evidence of network security controls. Service exposed over plain HTTP with no TLS.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in VPC with private subnets. Place behind ALB or API Gateway with TLS termination.

findings.title: API Entry Point - No gateway or load balancer
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront entry point. SOAP service exposed directly on JBoss port 8080.
findings.gap: Service exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Place API Gateway or ALB in front of the service for throttling, auth, and request validation.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling - No scaling configured
findings.description: No auto-scaling configuration found. Service runs on a single JBoss instance with no scaling mechanism.
findings.gap: No auto-scaling — all capacity statically provisioned on a single instance.
findings.recommendation: After containerization, configure ECS/EKS auto-scaling based on request count or CPU.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery - No backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. Self-managed Oracle 11g with no backup evidence.
findings.gap: No backup configuration. Data loss risk is unmitigated.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS/Aurora with automated backups. In interim, implement Oracle RMAN backups.

findings.title: High Availability - Single instance, no fault isolation
findings.description: No multi-AZ configuration found. Service runs on single JBoss instance. Database connection points to single IP.
findings.gap: All resources in single AZ or single host. No fault isolation.
findings.recommendation: Configure Multi-AZ for RDS and deploy compute across 2+ AZs behind ALB.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage - No IaC
findings.description: No Infrastructure as Code found. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Helm, or any IaC files exist.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage — all infrastructure manually created.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in Terraform or CDK: VPC, compute, database, and operational resources.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation - No pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline found. README states build is Ant with wsgen/wsimport run by hand.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all builds and deployments are manual.
findings.recommendation: Create CI/CD pipeline with build, test, security scan, and deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages - Java 6 with JAX-WS (compound legacy)
findings.description: Java 6 with JAX-WS on JBoss AS 5.1. Compound legacy regression across language version, framework, and SDK.
findings.gap: Language, framework, and runtime all deeply end-of-life. No AWS SDK integration possible without version upgrade.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 17+ with Spring Boot 3.x or Quarkus. Replace JAX-WS with REST. Add AWS SDK v2.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices - Tightly-coupled single class
findings.description: Single class with all logic in one method: XML parsing, data extraction, JDBC connection, SQL execution. No module boundaries.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries. All responsibilities interleaved.
findings.recommendation: Refactor into layered architecture: controller, service, repository. See Decomposition Strategy.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication - All synchronous SOAP
findings.description: All communication is synchronous SOAP over HTTP. Partner blocks until database INSERT completes.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. Partner tightly coupled to database latency.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async order processing with SQS/EventBridge. Return acknowledgment immediately.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling - All operations synchronous
findings.description: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No async job framework, no status polling, no callbacks.
findings.gap: No async job processing infrastructure for operations that may exceed 30s.
findings.recommendation: Implement async processing with status polling for order submissions. Use SQS for job queuing.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy - No versioning
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. SOAP endpoint has no version identifier in namespace, URL, or WSDL.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly to all partners.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-path versioning when migrating to REST. Version WSDL namespace in interim.

findings.title: Service Discovery - Partial DNS, hardcoded DB IP
findings.description: WSDL references DNS hostname for service but database connection uses hardcoded IP (10.0.9.30). Partial pattern.
findings.gap: Environment variables for service endpoint but no dynamic discovery. Database endpoint hardcoded.
findings.recommendation: Externalize all endpoints to environment variables or AWS Service Discovery.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage - PO XML not persisted
findings.description: Purchase order XML received, parsed in memory, and discarded. Raw documents not stored in managed object storage.
findings.gap: Unstructured data (PO XML) not stored or accessible for audit, analytics, or reprocessing.
findings.recommendation: Store raw purchase order XML in S3 with lifecycle policies for audit trail and reprocessing.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer - Direct JDBC in business logic
findings.description: Database access is direct JDBC with string-concatenated SQL in business logic. No DAO, no ORM, no connection pool.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered in business logic with no abstraction pattern.
findings.recommendation: Introduce repository/DAO layer. Use ORM or prepared statements with connection pooling.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL - Oracle 11g past EOL
findings.description: Oracle 11g reached end of Extended Support in December 2020. No version pinning in IaC. Engine past EOL.
findings.gap: Database engine past EOL with no security patches or support available.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Aurora PostgreSQL. Use AWS SCT for schema conversion and DMS for data migration.

findings.title: Stored Procedures - No stored procedures but raw SQL
findings.description: No stored procedures or triggers detected. SQL uses standard INSERT syntax. However, string-concatenated SQL approach is fragile.
findings.gap: While no stored procedures exist, raw SQL with string concatenation makes data layer fragile and Oracle-driver-dependent.
findings.recommendation: Replace string-concatenated SQL with prepared statements. Adopt ORM for database portability.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest - No encryption configured
findings.description: Oracle 11g stores partner order data with no evidence of encryption at rest. No KMS keys or TDE.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for database storing partner order data.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS/Aurora with encryption at rest enabled by default.

findings.title: API Authentication - WS-Security plaintext over HTTP
findings.description: WS-Security username token with password in plaintext over plain HTTP. No OAuth2, JWT, or modern auth.
findings.gap: No token-based authentication. Plaintext passwords over unencrypted HTTP.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to OAuth2/JWT. Enforce TLS immediately. Use API Gateway with Cognito authorizer.

findings.title: Centralized Identity - Self-managed flat file credentials
findings.description: No centralized IdP. Partner credentials in a flat properties file. No Cognito, OIDC, or SAML.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication entirely with no external IdP.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito. Use OAuth2 client credentials for partner M2M integration.

findings.title: Secrets Management - Hardcoded credentials in source
findings.description: Plaintext database credentials hardcoded in source: DB_USER='partner_app', DB_PASS='partner2009'. Committed to git.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source code — critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate credentials. Move all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening - EOL runtime, no patching
findings.description: JBoss AS 5.1 on RHEL 6 with Java 6 — all past EOL. No patching strategy or vulnerability scanning.
findings.gap: Runtime entirely past EOL with no security patches available.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to supported runtime. Enable SSM Patch Manager and Inspector after migration.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline - No scanning
findings.description: No SAST, DAST, or dependency scanning. No CI/CD pipeline exists. Known vulnerabilities (XXE, SQLi) in code.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools. Pipeline has no security validation.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST and dependency scanning when CI/CD is established.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing - No tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing instrumented. No X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, or trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing — debugging requires log correlation with no trace context.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK when migrating to modern framework.

findings.title: Business Metrics - No custom metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No CloudWatch putMetricData, no business event tracking.
findings.gap: No visibility into order volumes, success rates, or partner-specific metrics.
findings.recommendation: Instrument business metrics: orders submitted/accepted/failed by partner.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting - No alerting
findings.description: No alerting or anomaly detection. Errors returned to caller with no server-side alerting.
findings.gap: No alerting. Service failures invisible to operators until partners report.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: Integration Testing - No tests at all
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. README states 'No tests; partner onboarding is manual SOAP-UI session.'
findings.gap: No integration tests — only manual SOAP-UI testing. No regression protection.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests with Testcontainers. Create automated SOAP/REST test suites in CI/CD.

findings.title: Incident Response - No runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, no incident response automation, no self-healing patterns.
findings.gap: Incident response entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common incidents. Automate with SSM Automation after migration.

findings.title: Observability Ownership - No ownership defined
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS, no per-service dashboards, no alarm ownership or SLO definitions.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Define observability ownership with CODEOWNERS and per-service dashboards.

findings.title: Resource Tagging - No tags (no IaC)
findings.description: No resource tagging. No IaC exists to carry tags.
findings.gap: No tags on resources. No IaC to define tags.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent tagging when IaC is established.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: No IaC provisioning AWS resources. CloudTrail is account-level and not assessed in application repos.

evaluations.title: SLO Definitions
evaluations.reason: No deployed workload infrastructure in repo. SLO definitions cannot be assessed from source code alone.

evaluations.title: Deployment Strategy
evaluations.reason: No deployed workload found (has_deployed_workload=false). Deployment strategy cannot be assessed.

pathways.name: Move to Cloud Native
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: APP-Q2 < 3 (score=1) AND supporting: INF-Q1=1, APP-Q3=1, APP-Q4=1

pathways.name: Move to Containers
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: INF-Q1 < 3 (score=1) AND no container definitions found in repo

pathways.name: Move to Open Source
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: DATA-Q4 < 3 (score=2) AND commercial Oracle DB detected in INF-Q2 finding

pathways.name: Move to Managed Analytics
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: No data processing/streaming workloads exist in this service
pathways.not_triggered_reason: No streaming, ETL, data pipeline, or analytics artifacts found. Service has no data processing responsibilities beyond simple INSERT.

pathways.name: Move to AI
pathways.key_trigger_criteria: No AI/agent intent detected in portfolio or service context
pathways.not_triggered_reason: No AI/agent intent detected in portfolio or service context. Context field is empty.

decomposition_strategy.rationale: Service is tiny (single endpoint, single class). Full microservices decomposition not warranted. Containerize first, then modernize framework with proper layering.

approaches.name: Strengthen as Modular Monolith
approaches.reason: Service too small for this to be meaningful

approaches.name: Conditional / Adaptive
approaches.reason: Containerize as-is, then modernize framework with layered architecture

approaches.name: Big-Bang Rewrite
approaches.reason: Not recommended - high risk for any service
